theme: Dark-first, sophisticated, minimal, high information density

rules: No Inter or Roboto allowed anywhere.
Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for numerical values, financial metrics, and tabular data to ensure perfect tabular alignment.
Apply tracking-tight to all headings to maintain a sophisticated, dense look.
No global gradients or excessive glassmorphism. Stick to flat, solid matte surfaces.
Use #10B981 purely as a functional accent for positive numbers or primary CTA. Do not flood the screen with green.
Ensure strong WCAG contrast for all text over dark backgrounds.

grid.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-6

surfaces.shadows: None. Rely on 1px borders and slight background lightness shifts to distinguish elevation.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rounded-md. Matte finishes. Primary buttons use the brand green. Secondary buttons are transparent with 1px border-zinc-700 and hover:bg-zinc-800.
components.cards: Flat, cardless feel or ultra-subtle rounded-md with border-zinc-800. No heavy dropshadows. Background #121214.
components.sidebar: Darkest background (#09090B), border-r border-zinc-800, small text-sm links with hover:bg-zinc-900 transition.
components.tables: Dense rows. No alternating backgrounds. Subtle bottom border on rows (border-zinc-800). Mono fonts for numerical columns. Right-align monetary values.
components.badges: Subtle background tints (e.g., bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400) rather than solid fills to maintain dark mode aesthetic.
components.charts: Recharts. Remove default cartesian grid or set to very low opacity (#27272A). Tooltips must have solid dark backgrounds (#18181B) with 1px borders.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight, strictly sized to 16px or 20px for dense UI.

user_avatar.description: Professional man in dark suit, use for header profile dropdown.

login_background.description: Abstract colorful data lines on dark background. Use for left side of the login screen to add premium tech vibe.

chart_placeholder.description: Financial stock market chart on dark screen. Use as a placeholder if Recharts is not yet implemented or as an empty state for reports.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a standard React application (.js/.jsx format, NO TypeScript .tsx files) utilizing Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI primitives.
Strictly follow the Dark-first theme logic, setting app-wide backgrounds to custom #09090B (bg-zinc-950).
Ensure the layout has a responsive Sidebar (left) and Header (top).

Add font imports to your main CSS file: @import url('https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@400,500,700,800&display=swap'); and @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
Update tailwind.config.js to include these fonts in theme.extend.fontFamily (sans, mono, and a specific heading font).
Use Phosphor icons for all iconography.
DO NOT add generic AI bot images or illustrations. Keep the UI typographic, sleek, and data-driven.
Implement Recharts for KPI charts with a dark aesthetic. Use JetBrains Mono for chart axis labels and tooltip numbers.
For the 'SeekProfit' brand logo in the sidebar, use raw text with 'Cabinet Grotesk' font, tracking-tight.
Add 'sonner' for toast notifications, maintaining dark mode aesthetics.
All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, dialogs) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.
universal_guidelines: No centered layouts for app shells; respect natural left-to-right reading flow.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or sticky headers. Ensure content behind is completely obscured.
Always apply micro-interactions (hover, active, focus) on buttons and links, but exclude transitions on transform if animating.
Incorporate 2-3x more spacing for structural layout wrappers (e.g., p-8 instead of p-4 on the main content area) to give the dense data room to breathe.
